extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from the extraction job: IRF640NPBF, Infineon Technologies, n-channel MOSFET, LCSC C2568.

The supplied PDF is branded International Rectifier and identifies the IRF640NPbF TO-220AB variant within the shared IRF640N/S/LPbF datasheet; the extraction-job manufacturer is retained as Infineon Technologies.

Figures 1 through 7 contain usable typical electrical curves. Listed curve points are compact direct readings from visible plotted traces rounded to plotted-grid resolution; no points were generated by interpolation.

The strict MOSFET schema has no dedicated fields for absolute maximum ratings, gfs, IDSS, IGSS, gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery time or charge, inductances, thermal resistances, temperature coefficient, SOA, or avalanche ratings; available values are preserved here as notes.

Additional tabulated values: IDSS is 25 uA maximum at VDS = 200 V, VGS = 0 V and 250 uA maximum at VDS = 160 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 150 degC; IGSS is 100 nA maximum at VGS = 20 V and -100 nA maximum at VGS = -20 V; gfs is 6.8 S minimum at VDS = 50 V, ID = 11 A.

Additional gate-charge and switching values: Qg = 67 nC maximum, Qgs = 11 nC maximum, and Qgd = 33 nC maximum at ID = 11 A, VDS = 160 V, VGS = 10 V; td(on) = 10 ns typical, tr = 19 ns typical, td(off) = 23 ns typical, and tf = 5.5 ns typical under the switching-test conditions in the table.

Additional body-diode values: continuous IS = 18 A maximum, pulsed ISM = 72 A maximum, trr = 167 ns typical and 251 ns maximum at TJ = 25 degC, IF = 11 A, di/dt = 100 A/us, and Qrr = 929 nC typical and 1394 nC maximum under the same test conditions.
Thermal table values: RthetaJC = 1.0 K/W maximum, RthetaCS = 0.50 K/W typical, RthetaJA = 62 K/W maximum, and RthetaJA for PCB mount = 40 K/W maximum.

Absolute maximum ratings include VDSS = 200 V, continuous ID = 18 A at TC = 25 degC and 13 A at TC = 100 degC with VGS = 10 V, pulsed IDM = 72 A, PD = 150 W at TC = 25 degC, VGS = +/-20 V, EAS = 247 mJ, and TJ/TSTG = -55 to +175 degC.
